post.description: Create a new Job. To allocate an External Job, the active-tenant-id header's value must be set to the Vendor tenant id, and the claimId value passed in the request body must be the id of the parent project in the Insurer tenant.

VendorDetailsParentClaimRequired.value: Vendor details provided but the claim with id (jobInput.claimId) is in the tenant specified by the active-tenant-id header (i.e. Internal Jobs). Vendor Allocation jobs can only be created for a parent claim in a different tenant.

VendorDetailsNotRelatedToParentClaim.value: Vendor details provided but the claim with id (jobInput.claimId) is not a parent claim (i.e. Vendor Claim/Project Id was provided and this is not allowed). Vendor Allocation jobs can only be created for parent claims.

ClaimIdNotFound.value: Cannot find Claim with id (jobInput.claimId) in tenant specified by active-tenant-id header for internal job creation.

VendorIdNotFound.value: Could not find vendor with id: (vendorId)

JobTypeIdNotFound.value: Could not find job type with id: (jobTypeId)
